brief:
Settlers cut down olive trees and attacked the property of farmers in Marda, north of Salfit, according to Shehab Wire. The incident marks another in a series of settler incursions targeting Palestinian agricultural land in the occupied West Bank.

Details of injuries or the scale of damage were not immediately available. Marda lies in an area where Palestinian farmers have repeatedly faced restrictions on access to their land and encounters with settler groups.

title: Settlers cut olive trees, assault farmers in Marda north of Salfit
